subject: Renewal discovery + ingestion pipeline expansion / pilot next steps
messages:
From: Kevin Choi <k.choi@dataflux.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Asha Rao <asha.rao@dataflux.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 13:05:23 -0700
Subject: Renewal follow-up + ingestion pipeline questions

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks for the call earlier. Quick summary from my side so we have it in writing and can pull in legal/procurement:

Key context / pain: 
- We’re at ~30M tokens/month today (mix of chat & short single-shot prompts).
- Search/semantic retrieval latency is our biggest UX complaint — short (<2s) queries occasionally hit 3–4s tail latencies.
- We want to move embeddings indexing for a 500M-document corpus to a more predictable environment (current plan: dedicated or private).
- Compliance: SOC2 in progress; we need to understand audit log retention + key management options.

Goals we discussed: 
- Lock in a renewal term by end of July with a path to expand into a dedicated embeddings pool for the ingestion pipeline.
- Pilot (3–6 weeks) that proves latency improvements and cost per embedding.

Attached: usage-report-q2.csv and a short security checklist (security-reqs.pdf) that procurement asked us to complete.

Questions for Redwood team: 
1) Estimated cost range for a dedicated embeddings pool for our volume (ballpark monthly).
2) Expected timeline to stand up a private/dedicated environment (pilot -> production).
3) What SLOs / fallbacks would you recommend for the short-query tail?
4) Are there residency options (we prefer US but may need EU later).

I’ll loop in procurement/legal once we have a pilot proposal and rough numbers.

-Kevin

--
Kevin Choi
Head of ML Platforms, DataFlux.ai
kevin.choi@dataflux.ai | +1 415-555-0199

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kevin Choi <k.choi@dataflux.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 15:18:02 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal follow-up + ingestion pipeline questions

Thanks Kevin — great to sync. I captured our notes below and outlined the recommended pilot path so your procurement/legal team has something concrete to review. Please correct anything I’ve missed.

Recap of pain & goals (as we heard them):
- tail latency on short search queries hurting product UX (target: 95th perc < 750ms).
- need to move embeddings pipeline for 500M docs off current bursty infra to predictable capacity.
- SOC2 + KMS required; audit logs retention and access controls are gating.
- renewal decision targeted end of July; expansion decision within Q3.

Recommended pilot (Redwood propose):
1) Dedicated embeddings pool (quantized 8-bit candidate model we validated for semantic search) — reserve capacity sized for your current ingest + 30% buffer.
2) Prefix/KV caching + small short-query optimizer to reduce tail for sub-2s queries (should address the 95th percentile target).
3) 3-week technical validation (latency & throughput benchmarks with your sample dataset) + 3-week production pilot with real traffic.
4) Deliverables: latency report, cost-per-embedding calc, integration/runbook for your SREs.

Ballpark numbers (initial):
- Pilot monthly run-rate (reserved portion amortized over month): $18k–$28k depending on commit level and quantization config.
- Prod estimate (full 500M index embedding refresh cadence) will need an exact ingestion profile; we’ll model after we get sample traces.

Security & timelines: 
- We support customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS / GCP CMEK) and can provide audit logs with configurable retention (we’ll include options in the pilot proposal).
- Timeline: pilot environment in 2–3 weeks after PO + data access; full prod roll (if positive) in ~6–8 weeks. EU residency is available via our EU region for Dedicated — we can map that in the proposal.

Requested next steps / asks:
- Kevin: share a small sample of indexing traces (s3 link or anonymized CSV) and your preferred PO cadence.
- Kevin/procurement: if you want an NDA/standard reseller terms in advance, flag now — I can push a DocuSign link.
- Internal: Marcus/Monica — can you review the attached pilot-proposal-dataflux.pdf and the resource ask? Marcus, we’ll likely want a devops engineer + one infra slot for the pilot.

I’ll prepare a one-page pilot SOW and a Docs+pricing appendix and send it this afternoon. If that works, can we lock a follow-up tech sync next Thu (23 Jul) to align on instrumentation and samples?

Thanks — Stephanie

--
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0147

- PO cadence: standard 30-day net; for the pilot we can do a one-time PO for the month.

Infra/engineering notes (from Asha):

- Our preferred start date for the pilot is week of 27 Jul (gives us two weeks to get legal/PO in place).

S3 sample: https://s3.dataflux.ai/samples/dfx-embedding-sample-2026-07-15.tar.gz

Can you also confirm whether the latency optimizer requires any client-side SDK changes or if it’s pure serving-layer config? Our engineers prefer minimal client integration.

-Kevin
